options.A: All disposable income not spent on con sumption
options.B: All savings deposits in all banks during the year
options.C: All savings and time deposits in all banks during the year

questions.question: Which of the following combination is a veritable set of development indicators?

options.A: Growth of government expenditure and imports
options.B: Growth of population and national income
options.C: High fertility, literacy and school enrolment rates
options.D: Low infant mortality and high per capita income and literacy rate
